    06 / GOOD QUESTIONS

    A little more clarity.

    Something else on your mind?

    How do we get started?+

    Use the quote calculator to shape your project, then send your estimate by email or WhatsApp. We’ll discuss your goals and confirm a written scope before any work begins.

    How long will my website take?+

    A standard business website typically follows the illustrative 4–5 week process above. Complexity, content and feedback can change that; your actual delivery dates are agreed with your quote.

    Will my website work on mobile?+

    Yes. Responsive layouts are included across the packages. The experience is designed to adapt to phone, tablet and desktop screens, with reduced-motion and 3D fallbacks where needed.

    Are hosting and domains included?+

    Domain registration, hosting, subscriptions and ongoing maintenance are separate from the indicative build prices. This website is static and can be hosted on GitHub Pages; other projects may need different hosting.

    Are the portal and assistant live services?+

    They are interactive demonstrations. The portal uses fictional data, and the assistant gives predefined answers locally. Neither accesses client records, sends messages, uses AI services or creates an account.

    Can I request something custom?+

    Absolutely. Tell us about your workflow, integrations or 3D idea. Custom applications and backend services need an individually agreed scope and quote.

    A LITTLE TRANSPARENCY

    Privacy & demonstrations.

    This static website has no analytics, account system or backend form storage. The quote calculator, scripted assistant and fictional client portal run in your browser. They do not submit data to KPM.

    A session-storage flag remembers whether you have seen the intro in this browser tab. Chat and portal interactions are held in memory and reset when the page reloads. The downloaded estimate is generated on your device.

    Email and WhatsApp links open external services with your draft enquiry. Those services apply their own privacy policies. Three.js is bundled locally; no third-party script CDN is contacted at runtime.

    Portfolio entries are labeled concepts, and prices are indicative. For real project enquiries, contact kingkpm121@gmail.com.
